research_questions.zero_shot: Retained from the completed TrajAir-to-Tartan evaluation and not rerun.
research_questions.target_only: Can each method learn the target airport when trained only on its registered training dates?
research_questions.full_finetune: Does TrajAir pretraining improve learning on the same registered target dates?
research_questions.cross_airport: How do target-trained models transfer between KBTP and KAGC without target-airport tuning?

training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch; development metrics are diagnostic only
training.data_efficiency_expansion_rule: Run 0.1 and 0.25 with seed 42 first; expand only if the preregistered development trend is interpretable.

test_lock.policy: No model inference on either test split until all five-seed 100-percent checkpoints are complete.
test_lock.inference_unit: calendar date paired block bootstrap; overlapping windows are not treated as independent

claim_boundaries: Target-only, full-finetune, zero-shot, and cross-airport results answer different research questions and are reported separately.
The Tartan cohort is retrospective and has been inspected during engineering; it is locked, not blinded.
KBTP and KAGC differ in airport operations, traffic mix, runway geometry, and geography; effects are not attributed to geography alone.
Safety outputs are research proxies and are not regulatory safety assurance.
